core_obligations: Kernel identification (proof lines 3374-3389): the Picard map is surjective, and the units sequence with the Leray inclusion identifies the kernel of Pic(X) -> Pic(X') with the cokernel of theta: H^0(X', O_{X'}^*) -> k, giving the exact sequence (k, +) -> Pic(X) -> Pic(X') -> 0.

Injectivity (proof lines 3390-3395): for X' proper and reduced, every global regular function is a scalar, so the theta map vanishes on the relevant quotient and the additive map (k, +) -> Pic(X) is injective.
proof_roadmap: Establish surjectivity of the Picard map.
Derive the units sequence and the Leray inclusion to identify the kernel.
Dispatch the injectivity via the scalar-valued regular functions.
